title: Design System: The Hobbit Pick Order

display.purpose: Primary task headings and dominant leading-card names.

headline.purpose: Product identity and compact section commands.

title.purpose: Card names and other high-scan row content.

search.purpose: Primary text entry with stronger presence than ordinary body copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase actions, states, counts, and directions.

shadows.name: keycap-tactility
shadows.purpose: Restrained lift for keyboard shortcut cues.

shadows.name: thumbnail-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates small card art from dense list rows.

shadows.name: search-focus
shadows.purpose: Deepens while the search field owns interaction.

shadows.name: pack-rail

shadows.purpose: Gives the winning card more physical presence.

components.name: App Header
components.description: Sticky rack-steel equipment identification with product mark and dataset provenance.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-app-header { display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 78px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--rack); border-bottom: 4px solid var(--lime); font-family: "Barlow", sans-serif; } .ds-app-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 12px clamp(18px, 3vw, 42px); } .ds-app-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; color: var(--lime); } .ds-app-copy { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-app-copy strong { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-app-copy small, .ds-app-count small { font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-app-count { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 188px; padding: 9px 24px; color: var(--rack); background: var(--lime); } .ds-app-count strong { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 2.65rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: .8; }

components.name: Dataset Stamp
components.description: A literal Pick Light provenance block that keeps data scope visible.
components.css: .ds-dataset-stamp { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; align-items: center; min-width: 188px; padding: 9px 24px; color: var(--rack); background: var(--lime); font-family: "Barlow", sans-serif; font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .09em; line-height: 1; } .ds-dataset-copy { line-height: 1.8; } .ds-dataset-count { justify-self: end; font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 2.65rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: .8; letter-spacing: -.03em; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The lifted scanner control used to find pack candidates quickly.
components.css: .ds-search-field { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr 38px; align-items: center; min-height: 70px; padding: 0 12px 0 19px; color: var(--rack); background: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--rack); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(20, 32, 25, .11); font-family: "Barlow", sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-search-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--lime-dark); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(20, 32, 25, .16); } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); } .ds-search-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-search-input { min-width: 0; height: 66px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--rack); caret-color: var(--orange); background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font: 600 clamp(1.12rem, 2.2vw, 1.4rem)/1.2 "Barlow", sans-serif; } .ds-search-clear { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; color: var(--paper); background: var(--rack); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-clear:hover { background: var(--orange); } .ds-search-clear:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-search-clear:active { transform: scale(.96); } .ds-search-clear svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; }

components.name: Dark Icon Button
components.description: Compact square utility action for clearing or removing content.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Clear search"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; color: var(--paper); background: var(--rack); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--orange); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-icon-button:active { transform: scale(.94); } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; }

components.name: Result Row
components.description: One complete candidate action with thumbnail, rank lane, card identity, tier, and action label.
components.css: .ds-result-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55px 52px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; min-height: 80px; padding: 9px 10px 9px 4px; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Barlow", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-result-row:hover { background: rgba(255, 250, 240, .72); } .ds-result-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-result-row:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-result-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 55px; aspect-ratio: 125.3 / 176.4; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(20, 32, 25, .18); font-size: .55rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-result-rank { align-self: stretch; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-result-rank strong { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; } .ds-result-rank small, .ds-result-name small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-result-name { display: grid; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-result-name strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-result-meta { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: .35rem; } .ds-result-tier { padding: 5px 8px; color: #fff; background: #a36830; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-result-action { min-width: 72px; padding: 9px 11px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--rack); border-radius: 5px; font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-align: center; }

components.name: Selected Result Row
components.description: The selected candidate variant with an explicit Pick Light confirmation label.
components.css: .ds-selected-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55px 52px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; min-height: 80px; padding: 9px 10px 9px 4px; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: var(--paper); border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Barlow", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-selected-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 82%, var(--lime)); } .ds-selected-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-selected-row:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-selected-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 55px; aspect-ratio: 125.3 / 176.4; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(20, 32, 25, .18); font-size: .55rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-selected-rank { align-self: stretch; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-selected-rank strong { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; } .ds-selected-rank small, .ds-selected-name small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-selected-name { display: grid; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-selected-name strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-selected-meta { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: .35rem; } .ds-selected-tier { padding: 5px 8px; color: #fff; background: #a36830; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-selected-action { min-width: 72px; padding: 9px 11px; color: var(--rack); background: var(--lime); border-radius: 5px; font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-align: center; }

components.name: Tier Chip
components.description: A compact categorical tier marker, shown here in the Tier S color.
components.css: .ds-tier-chip { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 34px; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; color: #fff; background: var(--purple); border-radius: 999px; font: 600 .7rem/1 "Barlow", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Confirmation Button
components.description: Pick Light pack-level action for an immediately understood operation.
components.css: .ds-confirm-button { min-width: 72px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; color: var(--rack); background: var(--lime); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 .75rem/1 "Barlow", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .07em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-confirm-button:hover { background: var(--orange); } .ds-confirm-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-confirm-button:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-confirm-button:disabled { color: #7e897f; background: #2b3a31; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview:
This system feels like a purpose-built field terminal: operational, decisive, tactile, fast, and grounded. Warm stock carries the working surface, rack steel frames the decision machinery, and pick light confirms the action that matters. The atmosphere is physical and practical without becoming retro pastiche.

Information is organized like a pick list rather than a tier-list article. Compressed headlines, numbered lanes, literal labels, and immediate selection feedback let a drafter scan before they read. The system rejects fantasy parchment and generic dashboard polish; its character comes from workwear materials, signal color, and strict hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stock work fields against near-black rack-steel structure.
Acid-lime confirmation used as a pick light, not ambient decoration.
Condensed command typography paired with clear, compact body copy.
Numbered lanes, literal status labels, and decisive selected states.
Structural elevation with tactile shadows only where hierarchy needs them.

rules.name: The Signal Economy Rule
rules.body: Pick Light means selection, leadership, or confirmation; Safety Orange means exception or a consequential state change. Neither is background decoration.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the work field on Warm Stock or Paper Light; pure white is reserved for small contrast-critical details, not broad surfaces.

rules.name: The Compressed Command Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed at weight 900 for commands, ranks, and decisive names; never use it for paragraphs.

rules.name: The Literal Label Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase text must report a real action, state, count, or direction. It is not ornamental microcopy.

rules.name: The Decision-in-Reach Rule
rules.body: Search stays close to the results it controls, and the strongest current pick stays visible or one direct action away.

rules.name: The One Lifted Rail Rule
rules.body: Major surface elevation belongs to the pack rail; do not distribute card-panel shadows across the entire work field.

rules.name: The Radius by Authority Rule
rules.body: Large radii belong to major fields and rails, medium radii to decisive feature blocks, small radii to controls and thumbnails, and pills only to compact categories.

dos: Do use Pick Light only for selection, leadership, confirmation, and other immediate decision signals.
Do write controls and metadata as literal operational language: “Add,” “In pack,” “Clear,” and numbered ranks.
Do preserve visible rank order, keyboard focus, touch-sized controls, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use strong hierarchy before adding elevation: size, contrast, and position carry most of the work.
Do keep thumbnails physically card-like and subordinate to the card name and rank.
donts: Don't introduce fantasy parchment, medieval ornament, gold filigree, or lore-themed type.
Don't turn the interface into a generic analytics dashboard with soft blue cards and neutral SaaS chrome.
Don't use Safety Orange as a second primary action color or Pick Light as ambient decoration.
Don't wrap every row or section in a rounded, elevated container.
Don't replace literal state labels with ambiguous icons alone.
